verses.original: בָּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִתְגֹּֽדְד֗וּ וְלֹֽא־ תָשִׂ֧ימוּ קָרְחָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶ֖ם לָמֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: bā·nîm ’at·tem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem lō ṯiṯ·gō·ḏə·ḏū wə·lō- ṯā·śî·mū qā·rə·ḥāh bên ‘ê·nê·ḵem lā·mêṯ
verses.literal: You are sons of the LORD your God do not cut yourselves or shave your foreheads . . . on behalf of the dead
verses.literalPt: Filhos sois de Jeová, vosso Deus; não vos cortareis a vós mesmos, nem vos fareis abrir calva entre os olhos por causa dos mortos.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וּבְךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לִֽהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ‘am qā·ḏō·wōš ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵā bā·ḥar Yah·weh lih·yō·wṯ lōw lə·‘am sə·ḡul·lāh mik·kōl hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God The LORD has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all the peoples on the face of the earth
verses.literalPt: Pois és povo santo a Jeová, teu Deus, e Jeová te escolheu para lhe seres seu próprio povo, acima de todos os povos que há sobre a face da terra.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵal kāl- tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh
verses.literal: You must not eat any detestable thing
verses.literalPt: Não comerás coisa alguma abominável.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכֵ֑לוּ שׁ֕וֹר שֵׂ֥ה כְשָׂבִ֖ים וְשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer tō·ḵê·lū šō·wr śêh ḵə·śā·ḇîm wə·śêh ‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: These are the animals that you may eat The ox . . . the sheep . . . the goat
verses.literalPt: Estes são os animais que comereis: o boi, a ovelha, a cabra,

verses.original: אַיָּ֥ל וּצְבִ֖י וְיַחְמ֑וּר וְאַקּ֥וֹ וְדִישֹׁ֖ן וּתְא֥וֹ וָזָֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yāl ū·ṣə·ḇî wə·yaḥ·mūr wə·’aq·qōw wə·ḏî·šōn ū·ṯə·’ōw wā·zā·mer
verses.literal: the deer the gazelle the roe deer the wild goat the ibex the antelope and the mountain sheep
verses.literalPt: o veado, a gazela, a caama, a cabra montês, a antílope adax, a antílope órix e a ovelha montês.

verses.original: וְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֞ה מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֙סַע֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י פְרָס֔וֹת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl bə·hê·māh map̄·re·seṯ par·sāh wə·šō·sa·‘aṯ še·sa‘ šə·tê p̄ə·rā·sō·wṯ ma·‘ă·laṯ gê·rāh bab·bə·hê·māh ’ō·ṯāh tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: You may eat any animal that has a split . . . hoof divided in two . . . and that chews the cud . . .
verses.literalPt: Todo o que tem a unha fendida, e o casco dividido, e rumina entre os animais, esse comereis.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־ זֶ֞ה לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמַּֽעֲלֵ֣י הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֥י הַפַּרְסָ֖ה הַשְּׁסוּעָ֑ה אֶֽת־ הַ֠גָּמָל וְאֶת־ הָאַרְנֶ֨בֶת וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁפָ֜ן כִּֽי־ מַעֲלֵ֧ה גֵרָ֣ה הֵ֗מָּה וּפַרְסָה֙ לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֔יסוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- zeh lō ṯō·ḵə·lū mim·ma·‘ă·lê hag·gê·rāh ū·mim·map̄·rî·sê hap·par·sāh haš·šə·sū·‘āh ’eṯ- hag·gā·māl wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·ne·ḇeṯ wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·p̄ān kî- ma·‘ă·lêh ḡê·rāh hêm·māh ū·p̄ar·sāh lō hip̄·rî·sū ṭə·mê·’îm hêm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: But of those that chew the cud or have a completely divided . . . hoof you are not to eat the following the camel the rabbit or the rock badger Although they chew the cud they do not have a divided hoof They are unclean for you
verses.literalPt: Os seguintes, contudo, não comereis entre os que ruminam ou entre os que têm a unha fendida: o camelo, a lebre, o querogrilo, porque ruminam, porém não têm a unha fendida; estes são imundos para vós;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי־ מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֥ה הוּא֙ וְלֹ֣א גֵרָ֔ה טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִגָּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·zîr kî- map̄·rîs par·sāh hū wə·lō ḡê·rāh ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem mib·bə·śā·rām lō ṯō·ḵê·lū ū·ḇə·niḇ·lā·ṯām lō ṯig·gā·‘ū
verses.literal: as well as the pig . . . though it has a divided hoof it does not chew the cud It is unclean for you You must not eat its meat or touch its carcass . . .
verses.literalPt: e o porco, porque tem a unha fendida, porém não rumina, esse é imundo para vós. Não comereis da carne desses animais, nem tocareis nos seus cadáveres.

verses.original: אֶת־ זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- zeh tō·ḵə·lū mik·kōl ’ă·šer bam·mā·yim kōl ’ă·šer- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Of all the creatures that live in the water you may eat anything - with fins and scales . . .
verses.literalPt: De todos os animais que vivem nas águas, comereis estes: todo o que tem barbatanas e escamas, esse comereis;

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֵֽין־ ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ’ên- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ lō ṯō·ḵê·lū ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: but you may not eat anything that does not have fins and scales it is unclean for you
verses.literalPt: todo o que não tem barbatanas nem escamas, esse não comereis; é imundo para vós.

verses.original: כָּל־ צִפּ֥וֹר טְהֹרָ֖ה תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ṣip·pō·wr ṭə·hō·rāh tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: You may eat any clean bird
verses.literalPt: De todas as aves limpas podereis comer.

verses.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ תֹאכְל֖וּ מֵהֶ֑ם הַנֶּ֥שֶׁר וְהַפֶּ֖רֶס וְהָֽעָזְנִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh ’ă·šer lō- ṯō·ḵə·lū mê·hem han·ne·šer wə·hap·pe·res wə·hā·‘ā·zə·nî·yāh
verses.literal: but these you may not eat . . . the eagle the bearded vulture the black vulture
verses.literalPt: Porém estas são as de que não comereis: o abutre, o quebrantosso, o halieto,

verses.original: וְהָרָאָה֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אַיָּ֔ה וְהַדַּיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rā·’āh wə·’eṯ- hā·’ay·yāh wə·had·day·yāh lə·mî·nāh
verses.literal: the red kite the falcon any kind of kite
verses.literalPt: o gavião, o falcão e o milhafre, segundo a sua espécie;

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ō·rêḇ lə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: any kind of raven
verses.literalPt: todo corvo, segundo a sua espécie;

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־ הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ baṯ hay·ya·‘ă·nāh wə·’eṯ- hat·taḥ·mās wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·ḥap̄ wə·’eṯ- han·nêṣ lə·mî·nê·hū
verses.literal: the ostrich the screech owl the gull any kind of hawk
verses.literalPt: o avestruz, a coruja, a gaivota e o açor, segundo a sua espécie;

verses.original: אֶת־ הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־ הַיַּנְשׁ֖וּף וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hak·kō·ws wə·’eṯ- hay·yan·šūp̄ wə·hat·tin·šā·meṯ
verses.literal: the little owl the great owl the white owl
verses.literalPt: o mocho, o íbis e o porfirião;

verses.original: וְהַקָּאָ֥ת וְאֶֽת־ הָרָחָ֖מָה וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haq·qā·’āṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ḥā·māh wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·lāḵ
verses.literal: the desert owl the osprey the cormorant
verses.literalPt: o pelicano, o abutre e o corvo marinho;

verses.original: וְהַ֣חֲסִידָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְהַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְהָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥă·sî·ḏāh wə·hā·’ă·nā·p̄āh lə·mî·nāh wə·had·dū·ḵî·p̄aṯ wə·hā·‘ă·ṭal·lêp̄
verses.literal: the stork any kind of heron the hoopoe or the bat
verses.literalPt: a cegonha, a garça, segundo a sua espécie, a poupa e o morcego.

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֖א יֵאָכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl še·reṣ hā·‘ō·wp̄ ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem lō yê·’ā·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: All flying insects are unclean . . . for you they may not be eaten
verses.literalPt: Todos os insetos alados são para vós imundos; não se comerão.

verses.original: כָּל־ ע֥וֹף טָה֖וֹר תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ ṭā·hō·wr tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: But you may eat any clean bird
verses.literalPt: De todos os insetos limpos podereis comer.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֣וּ כָל־ נְ֠בֵלָה לַגֵּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר־ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֜יךָ תִּתְּנֶ֣נָּה וַאֲכָלָ֗הּ א֤וֹ מָכֹר֙ לְנָכְרִ֔י כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹֽא־ תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵə·lū ḵāl nə·ḇê·lāh lag·gêr ’ă·šer- biš·‘ā·re·ḵā tit·tə·nen·nāh wa·’ă·ḵā·lāh ’ōw mā·ḵōr lə·nā·ḵə·rî kî ‘am qā·ḏō·wōš ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō- ṯə·ḇaš·šêl gə·ḏî ba·ḥă·lêḇ ’im·mōw
verses.literal: You are not to eat any carcass you may give it to the foreigner residing within your gates and he may eat it or you may sell it to a foreigner For you are a holy people belonging to the LORD your God You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk
verses.literalPt: Não comereis a carne de um animal que morre por si. Poderás dá-la ao peregrino que está das tuas portas para dentro, para que a coma, ou poderás vendê-la ao estrangeiro; porque és povo santo a Jeová, teu Deus. Não cozerás o cabrito no leite de sua mãe.

verses.original: עַשֵּׂ֣ר תְּעַשֵּׂ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תְּבוּאַ֣ת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ הַיֹּצֵ֥א הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aś·śêr tə·‘aś·śêr ’êṯ kāl- tə·ḇū·’aṯ zar·‘e·ḵā hay·yō·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh šā·nāh šā·nāh
verses.literal: You must be sure to set aside a tenth . . . of all the produce . . . brought forth each year . . . from your fields
verses.literalPt: Certamente, darás os dízimos de todo o produto da tua semente, a saber, de tudo o que nasce nos teus campos de ano em ano.

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּק֣וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַר֮ לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְךָ֙ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֔ךָ וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְךָ֖ וְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֣עַן תִּלְמַ֗ד לְיִרְאָ֛ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām ma‘·śar də·ḡā·nə·ḵā tî·rō·šə·ḵā wə·yiṣ·hā·re·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵō·rōṯ bə·qā·rə·ḵā wə·ṣō·ne·ḵā lə·ma·‘an til·maḏ lə·yir·’āh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: And you are to eat a tenth of your grain new wine and oil and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the LORD your God at the place He will choose . . . as a dwelling for His Name so that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always . . .
verses.literalPt: Comerás, diante de Jeová, teu Deus, no lugar que escolher para ali fazer habitar o seu nome, o dízimo do teu pão, do teu mosto e do teu azeite e os primogênitos do teu gado e do teu rebanho; para que aprendas a temer a Jeová, teu Deus, em todo o tempo.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִרְבֶּ֨ה מִמְּךָ֜ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תוּכַ֘ל שְׂאֵתוֹ֒ כִּֽי־ יִרְחַ֤ק מִמְּךָ֙ הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לָשׂ֥וּם שְׁמ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם כִּ֥י יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yir·beh mim·mə·ḵā had·de·reḵ kî lō ṯū·ḵal śə·’ê·ṯōw kî- yir·ḥaq mim·mə·ḵā ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lā·śūm šə·mōw šām kî yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: But if the distance is too great for you to carry that with which the LORD your God has blessed you because . . . . . . the place where the LORD your God will choose to put His Name . . . . . . is too far away . . .
verses.literalPt: Se o caminho te for comprido demais, de sorte que não possas levar o dízimo, por ser demasiado longe de ti o lugar que Jeová, teu Deus, escolher para ali pôr o seu nome, quando Jeová, teu Deus, te abençoar,

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֖ה בַּכָּ֑סֶף וְצַרְתָּ֤ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ בְּיָ֣דְךָ֔ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh bak·kā·sep̄ wə·ṣar·tā hak·ke·sep̄ bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tā ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bōw
verses.literal: then exchange it for money take the money in your hand and go to the place the LORD your God will choose
verses.literalPt: convertê-lo-ás em dinheiro, atarás o dinheiro na tua mão e irás ao lugar que Jeová, teu Deus, escolher.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֡סֶף בְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ תְּאַוֶּ֨ה נַפְשְׁךָ֜ בַּבָּקָ֣ר וּבַצֹּ֗אן וּבַיַּ֙יִן֙ וּבַשֵּׁכָ֔ר וּבְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽשְׁאָלְךָ֖ נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְאָכַ֣לְתָּ שָּׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֖ אַתָּ֥ה וּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh hak·ke·sep̄ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tə·’aw·weh nap̄·šə·ḵā bab·bā·qār ū·ḇaṣ·ṣōn ū·ḇay·ya·yin ū·ḇaš·šê·ḵār ū·ḇə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tiš·’ā·lə·ḵā nap̄·še·ḵā wə·’ā·ḵal·tā šām lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·śā·maḥ·tā ’at·tāh ū·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then you may spend the money on anything you desire cattle sheep wine strong drink or anything you wish You are to feast there in the presence of the LORD your God and rejoice . . . with your household
verses.literalPt: Darás esse dinheiro por tudo o que desejar a tua alma, por bois ou por ovelhas, ou por vinho, ou por bebidas fortes, ou por tudo o que te pedir a tua alma; ali, comerás diante de Jeová, teu Deus, e te regozijarás, tu e tua casa.

verses.original: וְהַלֵּוִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תַֽעַזְבֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·lê·wî ’ă·šer- biš·‘ā·re·ḵā lō ṯa·‘az·ḇen·nū kî ’ên lōw ḥê·leq wə·na·ḥă·lāh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: And do not neglect the Levite within your gates since he has no portion or inheritance among you
verses.literalPt: O levita que está das tuas portas para dentro, não o desampararás, porque não tem porção nem herança contigo.

verses.original: מִקְצֵ֣ה׀ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים תּוֹצִיא֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מַעְשַׂר֙ תְּבוּאָ֣תְךָ֔ בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִ֑וא וְהִנַּחְתָּ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: miq·ṣêh šā·lōš šā·nîm tō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- kāl- ma‘·śar tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯə·ḵā baš·šā·nāh ha·hi·w wə·hin·naḥ·tā biš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: At the end of every three years bring a tenth of all your produce for that year and lay it up within your gates
verses.literalPt: No fim de cada três anos, tirarás todos os dízimos da colheita do terceiro ano e o depositarás dentro das tuas portas.

verses.original: וּבָ֣א הַלֵּוִ֡י כִּ֣י אֵֽין־ לוֹ֩ חֵ֨לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֜ה עִמָּ֗ךְ וְ֠הַגֵּר וְהַיָּת֤וֹם וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְאָכְל֖וּ וְשָׂבֵ֑עוּ לְמַ֤עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā hal·lê·wî kî ’ên- lōw ḥê·leq wə·na·ḥă·lāh ‘im·māḵ wə·hag·gêr wə·hay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā wə·’ā·ḵə·lū wə·śā·ḇê·‘ū lə·ma·‘an yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: Then the Levite because he has no portion or inheritance among you the foreigner the fatherless and the widow within your gates may come and eat and be satisfied . . . And the LORD your God will bless you in all the work of your hands
verses.literalPt: O levita (por não ter ele porção nem herança contigo), o peregrino, o órfão e a viúva que estão das tuas portas para dentro virão, comerão e se fartarão, para que Jeová, teu Deus, te abençoe em todas as obras que as tuas mãos fizerem.
